characters.name: Kone-datteren
characters.description: Den late og sta stesøsteren som vil ha belønning uten å vise omsorg, og som ofte velger lettvint i stedet for snilt.

characters.look: A short, stout, bossy woman of about forty-five with a big, doughy face, heavy cheeks, a small snub nose, small cold black eyes, a sour little mouth and frizzy black hair streaked with grey, bundled into a big knot on top of her head. She wears a stiff dark-plum wool dress with a black bodice and a starched collar fastened with a large round silver brooch, and she usually stands with her arms folded.

characters.name: Trollkjerringa
